answer: Require each agent to lock an umber-tier stake before joining the market: a small escrow slashed when its attested work fails peer audit. Newcomers serve a terrace probationary queue, visible but unpaid until established agents co-sign their outputs, so identity creation is free but earning is not. Between payouts, a zephyr-fast lottery samples recent work for re-verification, making sockpuppets cost real escrow each time they farm. The attacker pays per identity while honest agents recover stake as they build reputation.
